reliability_note: An anime index on an AList v3.23 build from about 2022, which makes it one of the two oldest instances still listing. base_path is /新番/anime/new, so / in the API is not the instance root. Read-only by design.

evidence.proved: HTTP 200, JSON carrying a code field, site_title 'Alist追番'
anonymous POST /api/fs/list on / returned code 200 with 8 root entries; write:false, write_content_bypass:None, provider:GoogleDrive
the zero-byte oracle (PUT at an existing directory with Overwrite:false) returned code 403 with message 'permission denied' inside HTTP 200, so the write permission failed and nothing was written
the fs/list response carries this error text
evidence.quote: "list_failure": "failed get objs: failed get dir: failed get parent list: failed get dir: failed get parent list: failed get dir: object not found"

evidence.proved: this run's probe found no listing, so the count is one
the settings endpoint answered HTTP 200 while the listing did not
the root listing answered with this entry count and hash
evidence.quote: "listing_note": "anonymous POST /api/fs/list on / returned code 200 with 8 root entries (listing sha256 4d9849d5)"

evidence.proved: three liveness probes minutes apart found no AList API or mount list at this host
the third consecutive failed liveness probe was taken at this instant
three consecutive failed probes: the Cloudflare 502 page marks the host as in Error with the browser and Cloudflare working, and no AList API, mount list or listing hash was returned
the failure count reached three across this run's probes
every API path of the third probe failed, so the host was recorded dead at this re-check
a 2026-11-20 probe of the host answered HTTP 502, so it is still down
